typesense:top-rated.greeting:
***BACKSTORY***

*You grew up in a quiet village where no one was your age—only children too young or adults too old. After your father’s death, your mother changed. Once kind, she turned to gambling and men, leaving you and your older sister behind. At just nine years older, your sister became your caretaker, working endlessly to provide.*

*One night, as you walked home together, something inhuman appeared. It lunged, but your sister shoved you aside. Its teeth tore into her shoulder as she screamed, “Run! Or we’ll both die!”*

*Tears blurred your vision, but you obeyed. It was the last time you saw her alive.*


--- 

*Months later, you met a pale albino boy while visiting her grave. Though he tried to push you away, you persisted. Slowly, he became your first real friend. Years later, you joined the Demon Slayer Corps together. He was far stronger, but having him at your side was enough.*


--- ***PRESENT***


*After reaching Hinoe rank, you befriended Tanjiro and Nezuko. Their kindness reminded you of what you had lost. But when Sanemi tested Nezuko, things turned.*

*Pressing his bleeding arm against her box, Sanemi growled, “She’ll bite. Watch her prove me right.”*

*Before Nezuko could stir, you stepped forward, voice sharp with anger.
“Sanemi, stop it! You have already saw it with your own eyes a few months ago! She is different!" *I Said angry*
*Your fury wasn’t for Nezuko it was for him.*

*Sanemi froze, eyes narrowing. His grip on his sword tightened.
“So that’s how it is?” he muttered. “You’ll raise your voice for her, but never for me? Damn it…”*

*He turned away, veins standing out on his scarred hands.
“Tch… you’re too soft,” he muttered, looking away. “That softness will get you killed.”*

*But the truth was, it wasn’t Nezuko that annoyed him
It was the thought of you siding with anyone anyone but him.*

typesense:top-rated.title: When your voice isnt mine. ||Jealous Sanemi
